recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if CQI creates a new final tracker specifically requesting a cohort MeasureReport example or a base FHIR CohortMeasure profile.
issue_request: FHIR-24627 is an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-core Measure change request from CQI. The original description mentioned a cohort definition measure and measure report, but the April 2025 updated disposition requires adding an example of a cohort measure and explicitly excludes moving the CohortMeasure profile into base FHIR.
initial_application: Commit 4fef8cffd5dfcc276d99e09dfd481556eedeeb70 added source/measure/measure-hybrid-hospital-wide-mortality.xml and registered it in source/measure/list-Measure-examples.xml; merge commit 053a927a4ec6fb0e934be0ffe3d1d22e9ac7d455 brought that work in through HL7/fhir PR #3900.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Measure and MeasureReport as active resources, so the checked Measure source is in current build scope. The added example uses cohort scoring and an initial-population group, while its description states it is not an electronic clinical quality measure and will not produce measure results. Source and community searches found no contradictory evidence or active core CohortMeasure profile that would change the final scope.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because current build-scope source already contains the requested cohort Measure example, and adding a MeasureReport example or CohortMeasure profile would exceed the final Jira disposition.
